commands.command:
set -eu
echo 'BASELINE'
git fetch origin work/ux-evolution
git rev-parse HEAD origin/work/ux-evolution
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/work/ux-evolution)"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo 'CENSUS_REAL'
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re, collections
by_path={}
for p in Path('apps/mobile/src').rglob('*.tsx'):
 if p.name.endswith('.test.tsx') or p.name.endswith('.spec.tsx'):continue
 s=p.read_text()
 tags=list(re.finditer(r'<(button|input|select|textarea)(?=[\s/>])',s))
 if not tags:continue
 by_path[str(p)]=[(m.group(1),s.count('\n',0,m.start())+1) for m in tags]
print('count',sum(len(v) for v in by_path.values()),'files',len(by_path),'tags',dict(collections.Counter(t for v in by_path.values() for t,l in v)))
for p,v in sorted(by_path.items()):
 print(p,', '.join(f'{tag}:{ln}' for tag,ln in v))
PY
echo 'TARGETED_NEW_CONFIRMATION_TESTS'
pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile exec vitest run src/features/thermometers/components/SensorRemovalBlockedModal.test.tsx src/features/plugs/components/PlugDeleteConfirmModal.test.tsx src/__tests__/modal.test.tsx --reporter=default
echo 'TYPECHECK'
pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile typecheck
echo 'ICON_BUNDLE_REFERENCES'
grep -R -nE 'IonIcon|ionicons/icons|import .*ionicons' apps/mobile/src --include='*.tsx' --include='*.ts' | head -75 || true
echo 'QUALITY_HARD_BUDGET_CONFIG'
grep -R -nE 'maxJs|chunk.*count|1536098|686363' scripts/performance scripts/quality 2>/dev/null | head -45 || true
echo 'HOST'
uptime
git status --short
